@sketch
Feature: Circle center point

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: circle-center-point-10 Enter a diameter through circle creation
    Given an editable metric sketch with a midpoint line
    When the user invoke Center Point Circle using Ctrl+Shift+C
    And the user select the recorded free center at (0.000, 6.553, -12.440) mm
    Then the prompt requests a point on the circle
    And the status displays a radius of 0.000 mm
    When the user enter 6 in the active size field
    And the user press Return
    Then the command returns to center selection with a 6 mm circle dimension retained
    When the user exit and measure the circle
    Then its diameter is 6.000 mm and radius is 3.000 mm
    And its global center is (0.000, 6.553, -12.440) mm within displayed precision

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: circle-center-point-11 Edit diameter while retaining the measured center
    Given the recorded circle has a driving diameter dimension equal to 6 mm
    And its displayed center is (0.000, 6.553, -12.440) mm
    When the user open the diameter dimension and accept the value 8 mm
    And the user exit General Dimension and measure the circle
    Then diameter is 8.000 mm and radius is 4.000 mm
    And its measured center remains (0.000, 6.553, -12.440) mm
    When the user close Measure and undo the edit
    Then the visible dimension and extent return to 6 mm
    When the user redo the edit
    Then the visible dimension and extent return to 8 mm
    When the user undo once more
    Then the 6 mm baseline is restored with the surrounding midpoint line retained

  @acceptance @documented_observation @needs_fixture
  Scenario: circle-center-point-01 Commit the intended result
    Given the MCAD Software is running
    And an editable planar sketch is active
    When the user select Center Point Circle, click a center, then a distinct circumference point
    Then one circle has the selected center and passes through the circumference point
    And the command returns to Select center of circle

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: circle-center-point-06 Cancel after choosing only the center
    Given an editable sketch is Ready
    When the user select Center Point Circle from the dropdown
    And the user select a center
    Then the prompt requests a point on the circle
    When the user press Escape
    Then the MCAD Software returns to Ready without a new circle

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: circle-center-point-07 Create a free circle and undo and redo it
    Given an editable sketch is Ready
    When the user invoke Center Point Circle
    And the user select a center and a distinct circumference point
    Then a circle appears and the command requests another center
    When the user press Escape
    Then the circle is retained
    When the user undo
    Then the circle is removed
    When the user redo
    Then the circle returns

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: circle-center-point-08 Measure the restored mouse-created circle
    Given the upper-right center-point circle has been restored by redo
    When the user open Measure and select its circumference
    Then Measure displays diameter 8.375 mm and radius 4.187 mm
        And center X 0.000 mm, Y 27.574 mm, Z -85.283 mm

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: circle-center-point-09 Keep selecting circumference after a same-position click
    Given an editable sketch is Ready
    When the user invoke Center Point Circle
    And the user select a center
    And the user click the same screen position for its circumference
    Then Select point on circle remains active
    And the displayed radius is 0.000 mm
    And no error dialog or new circle appears
    When the user press Escape
    Then the MCAD Software returns to Ready

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: circle-center-point-12 Reject zero advancement and cancel through two Escape states
    Given an editable sketch contains the retained 6 mm circle and midpoint line
    When Center Point Circle is invoked and a free center is selected
    And the 0 key is pressed followed by Return
    Then the size field remains red with 0 and Select point on circle remains active
    And no modal error dialog appears
    When Escape is pressed once
    Then the numeric entry clears and a mouse-driven circle preview remains active
    When Escape is pressed again
    Then Ready appears and the preview disappears
    And the retained circle and midpoint line remain visible

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: circle-center-point-13 Cancel a proposed diameter and inspect the retained value
    Given the retained circle has a driving diameter dimension equal to 6 mm
    When General Dimension opens the diameter dimension and the selected expression is replaced with 9
    And Escape cancels the editor
    Then General Dimension remains active and the circle keeps its visible size
    When the diameter annotation is clicked again
    Then Edit Dimension displays the retained 6 mm expression
    When Escape closes the editor and Escape exits General Dimension
    Then Ready appears
